name: web_task
summary: Do something on a website the user points at or names: leave a comment, fill a survey or form, check out an order. Sam fills everything in its own browser and asks before the final post/submit/pay click.

args.url: string (optional: the pointed-at page is used)
args.goal: string: what to do, with every detail the user gave (text of the comment, answers, quantity, address…)
